title: owner-answer
description: One owner reply on a meeting's thread, ingested by the channel (m5) and consumed by answer application (m6).

answer-text.description: the owner's reply, verbatim; interpreting it is the consumer's job

thread-ref.description: opaque channel thread identity; compared for equality only, never parsed

answer-kind.description: what the ask was: a glossary doubt, or an unroutable meeting's destination
